item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"Each truncation removes one whole oldest tool step from the trajectory: the earliest remaining `thought_i`, `tool_name_i`, `tool_args_i`, and `observation_i` entries are dropped together.","span_ids":["react_step_append","react_truncate_impl","test_truncation_behavior"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"On context-window overflow, `_call_with_potential_trajectory_truncation()` makes up to three attempts for that subcall, truncating the trajectory after each caught `ContextWindowExceededError` before trying again.","span_ids":["react_retry_helper"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"If the planning `self.react` subcall ends in `ValueError`, `forward()` catches it, stops the tool-selection loop, and still proceeds to the extraction stage instead of failing the overall call immediately.","span_ids":["react_forward_fallback","test_fallback_after_plan_overflow"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The overall `ReAct` call only surfaces `ValueError` when the final `self.extract` subcall fails through the same overflow-retry helper, because that extraction call is not wrapped in `forward()`'s planning-step `try/except`.","span_ids":["react_retry_helper","react_forward_fallback"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"react_retry_helper","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":145,"end_line":155},{"span_id":"react_step_append","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":105,"end_line":112},{"span_id":"react_forward_fallback","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":98,"end_line":118},{"span_id":"react_truncate_impl","path":"dspy/predict/react.py","start_line":169,"end_line":185},{"span_id":"test_truncation_behavior","path":"tests/predict/test_react.py","start_line":214,"end_line":252},{"span_id":"test_fallback_after_plan_overflow","path":"tests/predict/test_react.py","start_line":256,"end_line":280}]}
